notes.title: Summer Sale Discount!
notes.content:
Hey Artists (or soon to be artists),

This summer, take a relaxing trip to the island. That's right, you too can be pulled into this puzzling canvas world for just $2.50 USD! Our sale lasts until June 5th - don't delay, pick up The Artist for half off today!

Best,
MM

notes.title: Full Walkthrough Released
notes.content:
Hey Artists,

If you're really stuck on the island and don't know what to do next, we've released a step by step walkthrough to help you out! Check out the Guides page on the Community Hub for more information, or [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=865559665]click here[/url] for a direct link to the guide.

Additionally, a patch will be coming later this week to address a few small bugs that were discovered after release. Until then, good luck on the island!

Cheers,
MM
